comparisons.assessment: Full guide already distinguishes layouts, selected calendars, future timed events, all-day exclusions and update limits. TimeTree public-widget purchase conditions are irrelevant to Cloud; no new guide or change justified.

concreteRecommendation.location: Separate fixed commitments from proposed blocks, or final review section
concreteRecommendation.proposedOriginalAddition: When a work block ends, review the task separately: did you finish it, or is work still outstanding? If more time is needed, estimate the remaining work and choose another realistic opening without moving an agreed appointment. Keep the actual deadline visible; moving a preparation block does not change when the report is due. A calendar block records planned time, not automatic task completion.
concreteRecommendation.classification: Original manual planning convention supported by the task-versus-event distinction, not a product feature claim.
concreteRecommendation.gate: Do not add completion buttons, automatic carry-forward, task sync or task-to-event conversion instructions without native evidence.
